paragraphs.text: The Red Mountains are a mountain range on the island of Oneah , part of the Domains of Dominaria . The mountains run along the center of the island, from Amjad in the north to Shanodin and Savaea in the south.

During the Goblin Wars , the goblins of the Red Mountains overran and destroyed the nation Oneah, leaving it depopulated. The Fall of Oneah was a stark reminder of the sheer power of goblins when given time to grow their numbers significantly.
